steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Le musée est en face de la banque.
steps.question: Where is the museum?
steps.explain: En face de means across from.

steps.fr: Je vais prendre l'autobus au coin de la rue.
steps.question: Where will the speaker take the bus?
options: At the corner of the street
steps.explain: The speaker says au coin de la rue.

steps.fr: La prochaine station est le musée.
steps.question: What is the next station?
steps.explain: The speaker says la prochaine station est le musée.

steps.question: What is happening on route 4?
steps.explain: The message announces a detour today.

steps.fr: La station est tout près du parc.
steps.question: Where is the station?
steps.explain: Tout près de means very close to.
